description:
Planning applications at or around a place, newest first, each with
    reference, proposal, status, decision as published, dates, distance_m and
    authority, plus counts by status over the newest 100 matches. `since` is an
    ISO date (received on or after); `status` filters; `radius_m` (default 1000,
    at most 2000) applies to uprn and postcode places.

    Applications are held for London authorities only. Elsewhere (Leeds, Bristol,
    anywhere outside London) the result is covered=false with a pointer to the
    authority and its portal: pass that on, do not say there are none. The
    normalised decision is often empty, so use the decision as published. Applicant
    and agent names are never returned. Do NOT use it to predict whether an
    application will be approved; for approval rates use planning_precedents.
    Free.

    `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry}
    (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: 25 rows per page by default, at most 100 (`limit`); more via `next_cursor`; a page is cut to 8 KB.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.
